headline: Master sign plan presented for a building under construction with a Cambria Suites hotel, residences, and retail on Bank Street, Cherry Street, and St. Paul.
summary: The Design Advisory Board recommends approval of one deviation: some blade signs are not within 4 ft of an entrance because of the building's design. The Cambria Suites hotel canopy sign and corner projecting sign are fully defined, and other tenant signs must come back for final approval. No members of the public spoke, and the public hearing was closed. The recording ends as the board moves into deliberation, with no vote recorded.
discussion: Blade sign placement: Some blade signs are not within 4 ft of an entrance, and the Design Advisory Board recommends the board consider approving that deviation. The decision is up to the board.

Sign look: The South building has limestone cladding and the North building has brick, so the signs differ, though many use dark gray backgrounds. The design aims to make the two look like separate buildings.
Tenant sign approvals: Signs with enough detail are included in the master sign plan. Tenant blade, window, and band signs must come back for final approval.
Parking direction signs: Large wall signs were changed to blade signs after a discussion of the directional sign exemption, which requires signs less than 2 sq ft and not illuminated.
